headline: Discussion of the 2027 budget and a proposed Hamden Jazz Concert series, plus an update on the Hamden Through Time 240 Project.
summary: The meeting will cover an update on the Hamden Through Time 240 Project and discussion of new projects and fundraisers. Members will also discuss the proposed 2027 budget and a proposal for a Hamden Jazz Concert series.
items: Executive session, if recommended by the town attorney
Old business: Hamden Through Time 240 Project Update
Old business: discussion on new projects and fundraisers for the Hamden Arts Commission to pursue
New business: discussion on proposed budget going forward in 2027
New business: present and discuss proposal for a Hamden Jazz Concert series
